newsitem.title: USA: Congo allocated $8 Mln PL-480 for US rice, vegoil.
newsitem.headline: Congo allocated $8 Mln PL-480 for US rice, vegoil.

text.p: Congo received allocations to buy $5 million in U.S. rice and $3 million in vegetable oils through PL-480, the Agriculture Department said Tuesday.

The authorizations would allow sale of about 13,000 tonnes of long, medium or short-grain milled rice or brown rice and about 5,000 tonnes of soybean oil, sunflowerseed oil, or cottonseed oil, excluding oleomargerine, USDA said.
Contracting period for both commodities was set for September 19-30 with delivery October 1-December 31.
